description.zh: 每次抽样算出的均值都会有点不同，它的波动大小叫标准误 SE = σ/√n；置信区间是估计值加减几个标准误，“95%”的意思是：照这个办法反复抽样，长期约有 95% 的区间会套住真值。
description.en: A sample mean comes out a little different every time, and its spread is the standard error SE = σ/√n; a confidence interval is the estimate plus or minus a few standard errors, and “95%” means that if the procedure were repeated, about 95% of such intervals would capture the true value in the long run.

en: what does a 95% confidence interval mean
does a bigger sample make it more precise

reason.zh: 中心极限定理让样本均值在 n 较大时近似正态、标准差为 σ/√n，所以才能用 ±1.96 个标准误围出 95% 的区间。
reason.en: The central limit theorem makes the sample mean roughly normal for large n, with standard deviation σ/√n, which is why ±1.96 standard errors bound a 95% interval.

label.zh: 区间与检验是一体两面
label.en: Intervals and tests are two sides of one coin

reason.zh: 两者用同一个标准误：双侧 z 检验在 5% 水平拒绝 μ₀，恰好等于 μ₀ 落在 95% 置信区间之外。区间报告不确定的范围，p 值报告在原假设下有多意外。
reason.en: Both use the same standard error: a two-sided z-test rejects μ₀ at the 5% level exactly when μ₀ lies outside the 95% confidence interval. The interval reports the range of uncertainty; the p-value reports how surprising the data are under the null.

question.zh: “95% 置信区间”是说真值有 95% 的概率落在里面吗？
question.en: Does a “95% confidence interval” mean the true value has a 95% chance of being inside it?

ask.zh: 真值是固定的还是随机的？每次重新抽样，变的是区间还是真值？
ask.en: Is the true value fixed or random? With each new sample, does the interval move or the true value?

ask.zh: 为什么样本均值的波动能用正态分布和 σ/√n 来描述？
ask.en: Why can the wobble of sample means be described by a normal curve with σ/√n?

reveal.zh: 真值是固定的，随机的是区间。95% 说的是这套“估计值 ± 1.96 个标准误”的做法：反复抽样时，长期约 95% 的区间会套住真值；对某一个已经算出的区间，它要么套住了、要么没有。
reveal.en: The true value is fixed; the interval is what is random. The 95% describes the procedure “estimate ± 1.96 standard errors”: over repeated sampling about 95% of such intervals capture the true value. Any one interval already computed either contains it or does not.
